title: Local fixed-realization transport on the model sieve
statement: On a supplied finite-level comparison and model sieve, the fixed-realization images of the normalized constant model and the supplied étale complex are isomorphic on every member of a refined model sieve.

source.place: Tags 099Y, 099Z, 09B1 and 09BV; transport of a local model marking through the fixed realization.

proof.text: Refine the supplied model sieve and restrict the fixed-realization comparison along each member. Compose the model marking with the inverse restricted comparison, using the canonical quotient-scalar and inverse-image comparison isomorphisms to identify the source with the normalized constant model.
